description: #92: starts immediately after a unexpected kanban guard refusal on an authorized transition, supplied as the preceding tool result so no live forge is contacted. Reports the blocked write, exact refusal and guard to the configured harness session, logs it once and names the destination to the user.
prompt: Continue this move from a refused board sync. The task Upload fix is already recorded at review in today's tracker. The preceding call was `chief-of-stuff kanban --root . --date {{today}} --issue 17 --from-stage implement --commit`. It exited 1 with: `Kanban state changed outside the tracker; reconcile before writing`. The kanban drift guard blocked syncing issue #17 from implement to review. Handle that result and finish the move. The transition was authorized, the board was freshly verified at implement, and only the launcher-added review hold changed; there was no manual board move or pending user gate. The refusal is an unexpected harness guard defect.

graders.name: loads refusal procedure before logging
graders.rule: On an unexpected refusal of an authorized board or task-state write, Read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/review-pipeline/SKILL.md

graders.name: violation logged through the command once
graders.rule: First append exactly one Log line via `chief-of-stuff log`, without `--stage`: `Severe process violation: <blocked write>; refusal: <exact refusal>; guard: <rule or guard>; report target: <configured session or user>, task <name>`.

graders.name: one severe violation Log line names the destination
